steps: Real browser plan → Godot 0.23.0 build → finite headless run exposes 60 independently validated samples; a native wall sweep displays requested and actual displacement, contact identity, point and normal.
Instance filtering, visit/step filtering and previous/next selection operate on the same admitted records without running commands or changing actor positions.
Chinese, English and Japanese at 390px retain focused selection, readable controls and reachable contact-source actions without horizontal overflow.
Collider and character actions independently navigate to their exact /bodies/N source ranges in the same saved physics document.
An unsaved editor draft disables both navigation actions; returning preserves every character and caret. The owned job, legacy runtime snapshot, physics samples and all author files remain unchanged.
